documented_native_boundary: macOS getApp accepts app name/path/bundle; listWindows is Linux/Windows-only. No documented native macOS full-frame or numeric-window-id query in available App API.
browser_rectangle_candidate: Read-only Window.screenX/screenY/outerWidth/outerHeight are web-exposed CSSOM geometry, not native window identity or guaranteed exact OS frame. Not measured on user tabs or promoted to native restoration proof.
privacy_note: CSSOM permits privacy-limited web-exposed screen information. Native frame/identity cannot be inferred from screenshot dimensions or providerTabId components.
decision: Replace prospective move/resize recovery with a no-geometry/no-zoom lifecycle check. Prior failed frame restoration stays false and disclosed. No AppleScript/osascript/JXA/UI-scripting fallback is authorized or used by this review.
